blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — While most Filipinos remained undecided on whether Vice President Sara Duterte should be convicted in her ongoing impeachment trial, more Filipinos expressed support for either her conviction or acquittal, results from a survey conducted by Octa Research showed. READ: VP impeachment trial: What the prosecution presented in 3 articles Based on the results of Octa’s survey conducted Sept. 28 to Oct. 4, Filipinos who said they would need to see the evidence against Duterte first dropped to 47 percent from 55 percent in July. “Combined, 46 percent now state a preferred verdict, up from 38 percent in July,” […]...
